observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down old school jumpstyle basics step-by-step with clear voiceover instructions. They demonstrate movements from a side profile with numerical overlays to guide counting.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction of the 5 parts of the old school basic step.
Counting 1 to 5 while demonstrating slow repetition.
Explanation of arm placement and balance.
Full practice to music at normal speed.

metaphors: Use your arms as a balancer

steps_taught.name: Oldschool Basic
steps_taught.description: Five-part jumpstyle basic starting with the right leg behind.

what_works: On-screen numbers corresponding to the counts
what_hinders: Only side profile is shown during breakdown

quotes.text: The old school basic step is divided into five parts.
Use your arms as a balancer without exaggerating.
The goal is to create balance while jumping.

evidence_segments.observation: Dancer demonstrates jumpstyle choreography in profile view.
Numbers 1 through 5 appear on screen matching leg movements.

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down a jumpstyle basic strictly into a numbered 1-5 sequence with on-screen numerical guides.
